cases.name: Gabrielle "Gabba" Hoffman Wilson
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Affectionately known as “Gabba,” she was a proud graduate of Poteau High School and Western Oklahoma State College and also attended the University of Arkansas Monticello. Gabba had a deep love for travel and the outdoors. Whether she was playing softball, barrel racing, coaching T-Ball, or spending time fishing, she found joy in every moment spent outside. She had a special gift for connecting with others—she truly loved people and was deeply loved in return, something that shone through in her role managing the Purple Plume. Above all, her greatest happiness in life was her babies, Kingston, and Kimber Jo, who were the center of her world, along with her deep faith, love, and commitment to her Lord."

cases.name: Kimber Jolea Daray Terry
cases.about: Her obituary said: "In her short but beautiful life, Kimber Jo brought endless joy to those around her. Her favorite color was pink, and she loved watching Tangled and Ms. Rachel. She delighted in dancing, clapping, and snuggling up for naps with her cherished Big Bear. She adored Mickey Mouse, enjoyed GiGi’s sweet tea, loved running the Purple Plume, and was affectionately known as the family’s little “lunch thief.” Most of all, she was deeply loved by her mommy, daddy, big brother Kingston, and all her family, whom she adored with her whole heart."
